request_summary: The Growth team needs measurement of the new online money-transfer signup-to-first-transfer flow to identify drop-off, and a weekly dashboard for leadership. Funnel conversion is currently unmeasured and GA4 is only partially configured.
objective: Measure conversion and drop-off across the signup-to-first-transfer funnel and deliver a weekly leadership dashboard of those rates by the end of the current quarter.
business_context: A redesigned signup-to-first-transfer flow launched last quarter; leadership suspects high drop-off but has no measurement to confirm or locate it.

stakeholders.responsibility: Owns event taxonomy and GA4 implementation

stakeholders.name_or_role: Data/Technical owner of signup web app
stakeholders.responsibility: Enables event instrumentation in the app

solution_options.name: GA4 event funnel + BI dashboard
solution_options.summary: Define a standard event taxonomy for the funnel steps, implement/complete GA4 tracking, and build a weekly leadership dashboard in the BI tool on top of GA4 (or its warehouse export).
pros: Fastest path to a leadership dashboard
cons: Depends on completing GA4 instrumentation in the app
PII handling must be validated in GA4 configuration

solution_options.name: Warehouse-based funnel from app events
solution_options.summary: Stream raw app events into the warehouse, model the funnel there, and serve the dashboard from modeled tables.
pros: Full control over funnel definition and history
cons: Higher effort; needs a pipeline and data model
Unlikely to meet the end-of-quarter target

recommended_option.rationale: GA4 is already partially in place and the outcome required is a weekly leadership funnel view within the quarter. Completing GA4 instrumentation and layering a BI dashboard is the lowest-effort path that meets the deadline. The warehouse option is stronger long-term but does not fit the timeframe and can be a phase 2.

solution_components.name: Signup web app events
solution_components.description: User interaction events across funnel steps (landing, signup start, verification, first transfer).

solution_components.name: GA4 property
solution_components.description: Event collection, funnel and attribution analysis; needs taxonomy completion.

solution_components.name: GA4 → BI/warehouse export
solution_components.description: Path to feed the BI dashboard (native connector or BigQuery export).

solution_components.name: Weekly leadership funnel dashboard
solution_components.description: Funnel conversion and step-level drop-off, refreshed weekly.

solution_components.name: PII handling in analytics
solution_components.description: Ensure no restricted PII is captured in GA4/event layer; classify funnel data.

success_metrics.metric: Landing-to-first-transfer conversion rate is measured and reported
Step-level drop-off identified for each funnel stage
Leadership dashboard adopted (weekly views by sponsor)

risks.description: It is unknown whether the signup app currently emits the events needed for each funnel step.
risks.mitigation: Audit current GA4/app instrumentation before committing to the timeline.

risks.description: The flow handles customer PII; capturing it in GA4/event layer could breach policy.
risks.mitigation: Governance review of what is captured; enforce no restricted PII in analytics events.

risks.description: No confirmed technical owner for instrumenting events in the signup web app.
Dashboard-adoption success is not currently measurable.

open_questions.question: Which funnel-step events does the signup app already emit, and via what mechanism?
What is the sanctioned path from GA4 to the BI tool (native connector vs BigQuery export)?
What customer data is allowed in the analytics layer under current PII policy?

assumptions.assumption: GA4 is the sanctioned digital analytics platform for this flow.
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Option and effort estimates change; may require a warehouse-based approach.

assumptions.assumption: A BI tool is available to serve the weekly dashboard.
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Adds tooling selection/procurement to scope and timeline.

delivery_dependencies.dependency: Signup app must emit the required funnel-step events
GA4 event taxonomy defined and implemented

handoffs.objective: Define and implement the GA4 event taxonomy for the signup-to-first-transfer funnel and validate tracking.
scope: Define funnel-step events (landing, signup start, verification, first transfer)
inputs_provided: Constraint: no restricted PII in events
open_items: Confirm which events the app already emits

handoffs.objective: Ensure the analytics implementation complies with PII policy and classify the funnel data.
scope: Review what customer data would be captured in GA4/event layer
open_items: Current PII policy specifics for analytics layer

handoffs.objective: Build the weekly leadership funnel dashboard once measured funnel data is available.
scope: Design funnel conversion + step drop-off view
open_items: Data source finalized (GA4 vs warehouse export)

handoffs.objective: Coordinate the end-of-quarter delivery across analytics, governance, and visualization.
scope: Track the instrumentation-owner gap to resolution
open_items: Assign technical owner for app instrumentation
